prompts.description: 一个高度描述性的提示，用于生成一张忧郁的中世纪年轻女子和她身后一个疏远、内心挣扎的男子的图像，强调情感细微差别、戏剧性光线（明暗对比）和历史插画风格。
prompts.content: A melancholic medieval young woman with a soft, sorrowful gaze, standing in partial profile. Her gown is slightly tattered at the edges, with a loosely draped neckline suggesting past elegance. Her head is tilted upward, yawning dramatically with her eyes closed and mouth open, eyebrows drawn with quiet distress. Behind her, a tall man stands closely, one arm placed around her waist, his expression distant and conflicted a cold, intense stare filled with superiority. The atmosphere is dim and dramatic, with soft chiaroscuro lighting, stone walls fading into shadow behind them, subtle painterly textures, historical illustration style, cinematic framing

prompts.title: 坠毁的轨道环段概念图
prompts.description: 一个用于生成 AAA 电影级游戏环境概念艺术的提示，描绘了一个巨大的破碎轨道环段在清晨薄雾中坠毁在草地山谷中。该提示强调了戏剧性的日出光线、半绘画写实主义和结构细节，以用于专业的游戏开发视觉效果。
prompts.content:
SCENE:
A gigantic shattered orbital ring segment has crashed into a vast grassy valley during early morning mist. The broken metallic arc stretches across the landscape, partially embedded into hills while smoke rises from damaged sections. Emergency access ramps, exposed interior corridors, dangling cables, and collapsed transport modules reveal believable scale along the wreck. In the foreground, scorched grass, scattered debris panels, and fractured alloy plating frame the viewpoint. Low morning sunlight cuts through drifting ground fog and smoke, illuminating the massive structure while distant mountains fade into soft atmospheric haze.
STYLE:
Production-ready AAA cinematic game environment concept art designed for professional game development visual exploration. Strong readable hierarchy with the crashed orbital ring as dominant anchor. Dramatic believable sunrise lighting interacting with smoke, fog, and reflective metal surfaces. Semi-painterly realistic rendering including brushed alloy, scorched terrain, structural steel, exposed machinery, and atmospheric mist depth.
prompts.translatedContent:
场景：
清晨薄雾中，一个巨大的破碎轨道环段坠毁在一片广阔的草地山谷中。断裂的金属弧线横亘于地表，部分嵌入山丘，受损区域冒着烟。紧急通道坡道、裸露的内部走廊、悬垂的电缆和坍塌的运输舱段展现出残骸令人信服的巨大规模。前景中，焦黑的草地、散落的碎片板和开裂的合金板构成了视角。低垂的晨光穿透弥漫的地面雾气和烟雾，照亮了巨大的结构，而远处的山脉则逐渐消失在柔和的大气薄雾中。
风格：
可用于制作的 AAA 级电影游戏环境概念艺术，专为专业游戏开发视觉探索而设计。具有清晰可读的层次结构，以坠毁的轨道环作为主导锚点。戏剧性且逼真的日出光线与烟雾、雾气和反光金属表面相互作用。半绘画写实渲染，包括拉丝合金、焦黑地形、结构钢、裸露机械和大气雾气深度。

prompts.title: 赛博朋克城市街区收藏级立体模型
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一个风格化的 3D 微缩立体模型，描绘一个分层的赛博朋克城市街区，结合了历史悠久的地面建筑和霓虹摩天大楼。风格被指定为高级收藏品，由光滑的陶瓷或树脂雕刻而成，具有干净、玩具般的比例和柔和的摄影棚产品照明。
prompts.content:
SCENE:
A layered cyberpunk city block combining low historic structures at ground level with towering neon skyscrapers rising above, connected by bridges, cables, and stacked infrastructure.
STYLE:
Render as a premium stylized 3D collectible miniature diorama on a fully visible, centered self-contained display base, shown from a slightly elevated 3/4 tabletop angle against a clean neutral studio gradient background. Maintain collectible figurine scale and clean display presentation.
All elements should appear sculpted from smooth matte ceramic, painted resin, or stylized polymer with rounded edges, simplified geometry, and slightly exaggerated toy-like proportions. Keep surfaces clean and intentionally stylized. Avoid fingerprints, rough handmade textures, workshop scenes, macro photography depth-of-field, or photoreal clay imperfections.
Use soft professional studio product lighting: gentle global illumination, warm key light, soft ambient bounce, controlled shadows, and optional warm interior window glow.
Render any water or translucent materials as poured clear resin with smooth transparency, subtle reflections, soft internal depth, and slightly thick stylized edges.
Include small environmental details but keep everything cohesive, simplified, and sculptural. Prioritize clean stylized modeling over photorealistic texture detail.
Overall intent: premium collectible miniature, stylized 3D marketplace presentation, cozy whimsical mood, smooth sculpt clarity, controlled studio rendering, avoid real-world photography aesthetics

风格：
渲染成一个高级风格化的 3D 收藏品微缩立体模型，置于一个完全可见、居中、独立的展示底座上，从略微抬高的 3/4 桌面角度展示，背景是干净的中性工作室渐变。保持收藏品手办的比例和整洁的展示效果。
所有元素应呈现出由光滑哑光陶瓷、彩绘树脂或风格化聚合物雕刻而成，具有圆润的边缘、简化的几何形状和略微夸张的玩具般比例。保持表面干净且刻意风格化。避免指纹、粗糙的手工纹理、工作室场景、微距摄影景深或照片般真实的粘土瑕疵。
使用柔和专业的摄影棚产品照明：柔和的全局照明、暖色主光、柔和的环境反弹光、受控的阴影以及可选的暖色室内窗户光。
将所有水或半透明材料渲染成浇筑的透明树脂，具有光滑的透明度、微妙的反射、柔和的内部深度和略厚的风格化边缘。
包含小的环境细节，但所有元素都应保持连贯、简化和雕塑感。优先考虑干净的风格化建模而非照片般真实的纹理细节。

prompts.description: 一个生成高分辨率、充满活力的萨迪·辛克（Sadie Sink）肖像的提示，她留着红色头发，梳着光滑的发髻，坐在一张亮红色充气椅上，嘴里含着一支绿色棒棒糖，露出银色烤瓷牙套。背景是中性工作室墙壁，配以明亮、定向的灯光，营造出夏日复古流行美学。
prompts.content: "This image features a high-resolution, vibrant portrait of a young woman with fair skin and striking red hair styled in a high, sleek bun with soft tendrils framing her face. She is sitting on a glossy, translucent red inflatable chair, leaning forward with a playful expression and holding a bright green lollipop to her mouth, revealing silver grillz on her teeth. She wears a white ribbed cropped tank top with a colorful graphic print, paired with distressed denim shorts. Her accessories include layered gold chain necklaces, large gold hoop earrings, a silver ring, and several gold chain bracelets on her wrist. The lighting is bright and directional, creating soft shadows and a summery, retro-pop aesthetic, while the background is a simple, neutral studio wall that makes the bold colors of the red chair and her ginger hair pop."
prompts.translatedContent: 这张图片展示了一位年轻女性的高清、生动肖像。她皮肤白皙，一头醒目的红发梳成高高的光滑发髻，几缕柔软的发丝垂落在脸庞。她坐在一张光泽、半透明的红色充气椅上，身体前倾，表情俏皮，嘴里含着一支亮绿色的棒棒糖，露出了牙齿上的银色烤瓷牙套。她身穿一件白色罗纹短款背心，上面印有彩色图案，搭配破洞牛仔短裤。她的配饰包括多层金色项链、大号金色耳环、一枚银戒指和手腕上的几条金色手链。灯光明亮且有方向感，营造出柔和的阴影和夏日复古流行美学，而背景是简单的中性影棚墙，衬托出红色椅子和她姜黄色头发的鲜明色彩。
